mapper.sql: outbox_id, message_id, message_code, envelope, attempt_count, version, target_handler_code, handler_attempt, handler_retry_rule::text AS handler_retry_rule
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO messaging_outbox (outbox_id, message_id, message_code, envelope, status, available_at, attempt_count, lease_id, lease_until, last_error, sent_at, version) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{messageId}, #{messageCode}, #{envelope}, #{status}, #{availableAt}, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0)

INSERT INTO messaging_outbox (outbox_id, message_id, message_code, envelope, status, available_at, target_handler_code, handler_attempt, handler_retry_rule) VALUES (#{outboxId}, #{messageId}, #{messageCode}, #{envelope}, 'PENDING', #{availableAt}, #{handlerCode}, #{handlerAttempt}, CAST(#{retryRule} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT (target_handler_code, message_id, handler_attempt) WHERE target_handler_code IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
mapper.select: WITH candidate AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT outbox_id, version, CASE WHEN status = 'SENDING' THEN lease_until ELSE available_at END AS claim_at FROM messaging_outbox WHERE (status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND available_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'SENDING' AND lease_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY claim_at, outbox_id LIMIT #{limit} ), leased AS ( UPDATE messaging_outbox AS message SET status = 'SENDING', attempt_count = message.attempt_count + 1, lease_id = #{leaseId}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, last_error = NULL, version = message.version + 1 FROM candidate WHERE message.outbox_id = candidate.outbox_id AND message.version = candidate.version AND ((message.status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND message.available_at <= #{now}) OR (message.status = 'SENDING' AND message.lease_until <= #{now})) RETURNING message.outbox_id, message.message_id, message.message_code, message.envelope, message.attempt_count, message.version, message.target_handler_code, message.handler_attempt, message.handler_retry_rule, candidate.claim_at ) SELECT FROM leased ORDER BY claim_at, outbox_id
